name: Mochatrade
long_description: Mochatrade lets global traders trade top US stocks using perpetual futures. Access all US stocks including TSLA, NVDA, and AAPL, plus pre-IPO companies and commodities, no US brokerage account needed. Money in and out in local currency (UPI in India), with professional-grade execution on the world's most liquid equities. Starting with India (140M+ demat account holders), expanding across other markets. Backed by Coinfund, Coinbase, and Y Combinator.
one_liner: US stock trading, unlocked for the globe

launches.title: Mochatrade - US stock perps for Indian traders with up to 50x leverage
launches.tagline: Deposit in INR via UPI, trade US stocks, Pre-ipo stocks, indices, commodities and crypto with up to 50x leverage.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Mochatrade lets Indians trade perpetual futures on US stocks (TSLA, NVDA, AAPL), Pre-ipo stocks(Cerebras, Anthropic, SpaceX), commodities(Oil, Gold, Silver). Deposit INR via UPI rails, trade and withdraw to your bank. 24/7 settlement and no Foreign Remittance required.

**The problem:** India is the largest retail derivatives market in the world with \~60% of global equity derivatives volumes (\~$30Bn per day), eclipsing the US market. 140M+ Indians hold trading accounts. They want US stock exposure but have been locked out.

Today they have three bad options:

* **Hold US stock as spot** through regulated brokers (Vested, INDmoney) with offshore bank accounts: $250K remittance cap, T+2 settlement, no leverage, no shorting, not 24/7, painful Tax handling
* **Offshore CFD shops**: opaque pricing, sketchy custody, no INR rail, regulatory black hole
* **Crypto Exchanges** such as CoinDCX which are catered towards crypto audiences. Majority of Indian daytraders don't understand 'crypto wallets' and 'gas fees'.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101161&key=user_uploads/1797347/625c590d-9442-488e-b1a6-57d01a7f147b)

**None of them match** what an **Indian** F&O **trader** actually does and **wants** - every day leveraged derivatives, in INR.

Promo: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YGTRcZ2tgRM>

**What we built:** The trading terminal these users already know, run on perpetual futures:

* **50+ US stock perps + pre-ipo stocks +commodities crypto + indices**, up to **50x leverage.** NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, META, GOOGL, SPY, plus BTC, ETH, SOL, plus index perps. One terminal, one balance.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101161&key=user_uploads/1797347/f4c0dbdf-56fb-4ea5-8f83-93f9e65df03b)

* **INR on-ramp and off-ramp via UPI.** Withdraw to your KYC-verified bank in INR.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101161&key=user_uploads/1797347/697099f0-bff6-4bac-8adb-ff50624f850a)

* **Terminal-grade UI** density built for serious traders. Fundamental Analysis for every stock, Advanced charts for Technical Analysis.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101161&key=user_uploads/1797347/39aac7df-4a94-4f57-8ff1-cc6e9eb3a24c)

* **Non-custodial wallets. Sub-second execution** and **deep liquidity**, built on Hyperliquid.
* **Compliance:** We're building it the right way. FIU-IND registration in flight, working with India's best law firm on regulatory architecture.

**Who we are:** **Utkarsh** (CEO), **Chetan** (CPO), **Parth** (CTO). IIT grads, close friends for 10 years. Previously **built** crypto **wallet** with **2M** installs across **50+ countries**, processing over **$2Bn** in volumes, successfully **acquired** by an exchange.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101161&key=user_uploads/1797347/d892d716-f736-4f5c-b942-a985239fe819)

**Our ask:**

* F&O / perps traders: join the **waitlist** at [www.mochatrade.com](http://www.mochatrade.com)
* **Operators** in Indian **fintech**, **crypto**, or **trader** communities - would love to chat
* We're closing a **seed round**; warm intros welcome

Contact us at: [founders@mochatrade.com](mailto:founders@mochatrade.com)
